candidate.answerReason: Each tile has shaded area 1-π/4 square foot. There are 80 tiles, giving 80(1-π/4)=80-20π square feet, agreeing with A.

methods.label: Combine the white quarter circles
methods.explanation:
The four white quarter circles in one tile have the same total area as one full circle of radius \(\tfrac12\) foot. Neighboring white regions only touch at side midpoints, since their two radii add to the tile's side length, so adding their areas does not count any area twice.

Their total white area is
\[
4\left(\frac14\pi\left(\frac12\right)^2\right)
=\frac{\pi}{4}.
\]
Each tile has area \(1\) square foot, so its shaded area is \(1-\tfrac{\pi}{4}\). The floor contains \(8\cdot10=80\) tiles. Hence its total shaded area is
\[
80\left(1-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)
=\boxed{80-20\pi}
\]
square feet, choice \(\text{A}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses circle area, subtraction of component areas, and multiplication by the number of unit tiles.
